items.title: [Assignment #1] Developing Your Own Business Concept
items.author: Program Coordinator
items.content: Dear Participants, Following today’s lecture, we are pleased to announce your first assignment. 1. Assignment Overview Identify a Business Opportunity within the context of Laos and develop it into a concrete Business Concept. 2. Key Guidelines When brainstorming your business idea, consider the following perspectives: * Market & Industry Analysis: Which industries show growth potential in the current Laotian market? * Problem-Solving: What specific inconveniences or existing problems do people in Laos face, and how can they be solved? * Demographics & Trends: What opportunities arise from changes in Laos' population structure or new lifestyle trends? * Personal Network & Information: How can you leverage your professional networks or unique information/resources? 3. Format and Length * Format: MS Word * Length: Approximately 2 pages (A4 size) 4. Submission Details * Submission Deadline: By this Sunday, May 3rd, 2026 * To: bchoi@hufs.ac.kr * Cc (Carbon Copy): seongeun38@kookmin.ac.kr * Note: Your idea can be changed or modified at any time throughout the course. The primary goal is to start the journey with "your own idea" rather than producing a perfect final product from the start.
